thread:
inc-bot: PAGER: Hosted runtime OOM storm detected in gpu-pool-11. Alert: runtime-prefetch-oom. Runbook: /runbooks/kv-cache-oom. Priority: P1

rory: seeing repeated oom_kill events across 8 replicas. Memory climbs rapidly after heavy chat imports. Prefetch counters spike then never decay.

sasha: recent config tweak? I merged a change yesterday to enable high-throughput quant profiles and bumped CONT_BATCH_MAX to 2000 for better throughput.

tony: correct — experiment `throughput-v3` enabled higher window + enabled aggressive kv prefetch for sessions marked `fastpath=true`.

rory: traces show enormous prefix lengths, often users pasting entire logs, 80-300k tokens. Continuous batching coalesced these into huge KV footprints.

priya: taking the pager. tagging infra and support. @here we might need immediate hot rollback.

ops-bot: Pager assigned to priya. Rolling incident channel created.

priya: mitigation options: 1) toggle experiment off (disable `throughput-v3` flag), 2) apply an emergency PREFETCH_WINDOW cap env var, 3) add request-side hard reject for >220k tokens with a helpful 413 message. Recommend do 1+2 immediately.

rory: agree. I'm preparing a rollback toggle for the feature flag in launchdarkly. Also prepping kubectl env patch.

sasha: prepared quick guard snippet for request path; will push once rollback is in progress.

rory: toggled launchdarkly flag `throughput-v3` -> off at 03:04:40 UTC. Observed drop in prefetch_rate on rotated pods.

rory: applying env caps now:
```
kubectl -n runtime set env ds/hosted-runtime PREFETCH_WINDOW_CAP=500000 CONT_BATCH_MAX=128
kubectl -n runtime rollout restart ds/hosted-runtime
```

ops-bot: rollout started by rory. 5 pods at a time.

priya: after first wave, memory pressure trending down on rotated pods. Non-rotated still show high mem until restart.

sasha: pushing request guard:
```
# quick guard in request validator
if request.context_tokens > 220000:
  return 413, {"error":"context too large (>220k tokens). Please chunk or contact support: https://redwood/docs/limits"}
```

ops-bot: guard deployed to prod by sasha. Verified with synthetic 230k token request -> 413.

am-kai: Customer impact: noticed elevated 502/503s for endpoints between 03:02-03:18 UTC. Affected customers: DataDrift, FinLedger. ~7.2k failed requests. Raised to AMs.

priya: status update: feature flag off, env caps set, guard in place. Memory growth stopped increasing cluster-wide. No new OOMs in last 6 minutes. Keeping the pager open for 45m.

rory: collecting heap profiles and kv_map diffs for postmortem. Early hypothesis: combined effect of increased CONT_BATCH_MAX and session-level aggressive prefetch caused unbounded kv_map growth for extreme context sizes.

sasha: additional follow-ups proposed:
- add age-based eviction for kv entries older than 30 minutes unless pinned
- limit per-session kv_entries hard cap (e.g., 500k) and return 429 when exceeded
- add CI e2e for very long prompts (200k+ tokens) to ensure batching/regression protection
- add alert for PREFETCH_RATE > X per minute and KV_MAP growth delta > Y

priya: customer comms: drafting a concise post-incident summary and offering support for impacted customers. AMs looped in.

rory: prepping rollback PR to permanently lower CONT_BATCH_MAX and remove aggressive prefetch condition. Will include tests and an e2e harness. ETA 5h.

priya: handing monitoring to rory for the next 30m. If any regen, page back oncall.

docs-bot: Created incident doc: /incidents/postmortems/2859999999. Placeholder for timeline + action items.

ops-bot: Incident marked mitigated (temp fixes applied). severity=sev2, started_ts=2859999800, mitigated_ts=2859999990, owner=priya. Postmortem required.

sasha: note for postmortem: evaluate false-positive risk of rejecting >220k tokens; maybe offer chunking helpers in SDK.

am-kai: thank you team; customers appreciate quick mitigation. Keep AMs updated with final root cause and ETA for permanent fix.

priya: closing slack loop for now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
